terminals.name: daphne-dev
terminals.command: export DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=config.settings_dev DEV_SQLITE_NAME=/tmp/cms-shop-dev.sqlite3 && set -a && [ -f "$HOME/.secrets/plt/default-user.env" ] && . "$HOME/.secrets/plt/default-user.env"; set +a && .venv/bin/python manage.py migrate --noinput && .venv/bin/python manage.py ensure_cms_spa && .venv/bin/python manage.py ensure_superuser --update-password && .venv/bin/daphne -b 127.0.0.1 -p 8083 config.asgi:application
terminals.description: Dev local: settings_dev + SQLite + ensure admin + content store en http://127.0.0.1:8083
